content.title: Crypto Exchange Gemini Raises US IPO Target to $433 Million
content.summary: The cryptocurrency firm led by the billionaire Winklevoss twins raised the price range to $24 to $26 per share from $17 to $19, according to a filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission on Tuesday.  The company is still offering 16.7 million shares in the IPO.  The company announced a $50 million private placement at the IPO price by Nasdaq Inc. earlier on Tuesday in a revised filing.
